corrections.reason: The skill asks kids to compare objects that have the same job. Judging that requires understanding what objects are for (g1-sci-object-purposes), which is not covered by either listed prerequisite. g1-sci-material-sources depends only on g1-sci-objects-materials, and g1-sci-waste-types also depends only on g1-sci-objects-materials, so neither brings in the purpose idea. Adding g1-sci-object-purposes is not redundant because no other listed prerequisite depends on it.

output.notes: Reviewed all 33 Grade 1 skills. Prerequisites are all Grade 1, none point to the skill itself, and I found no listed prerequisite that is already implied by another listed prerequisite. The one clear gap is g1-sci-compare-objects, which needs g1-sci-object-purposes. Two borderline cases were left unchanged: g1-sci-season-weather could arguably depend on g1-sci-earth-sun, since the idea of seasons comes from Earth's relationship to the Sun, and g1-sci-humans-respond could arguably depend on g1-sci-sun-light-heat for the daily-change part. I judged the existing prerequisites adequate for both, since g1-sci-cycles covers repeating seasons and daily changes. Titles and descriptions read clearly for listening.
